reasoning: The failing test `settings_remove_media_directory` uses `request.post('/api/settings/media-dirs', { data: { directory: scratchDir } })` at line 75 — Playwright's built-in `APIRequestContext`. This is a standalone HTTP client that does NOT share the browser page's session cookies. The application has CSRF protection enabled by default (`security.py` — `protect_unsafe_request` checks every non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS request). The `APIRequestContext` does not send the `X-CSRF-Token` header (which the browser's `security.js` interceptor automatically adds to all `fetch()` calls), so the server rejects the POST with a 403 JSON response (`{"error": "This request could not be verified...", "code": "csrf_failed"}`). The CSRF bypass conditions (`TESTING` or `DEMO_MODE` config) are not set in this test environment. Evidence: (1) the first test `settings_add_media_directory` adds a directory successfully through the browser UI (page-based interaction), proving the endpoint works; (2) no other test in the entire `generated_tests` suite uses `request.post()` — all unsafe API calls go through `page.evaluate()` or UI interaction to get the browser's CSRF token; (3) the `_support/media-test-data.ts` helper only uses `request.get()` (safe method, no CSRF required). The spec goal of adding-then-removing a media directory is fully achievable through the application — the test just uses the wrong HTTP client.
suggestedAction: Replace the direct `request.post()` call with browser-based interaction. Two options: (A) Use the same UI pattern as `settings_add_media_directory` — fill `#new-media-dir` with the scratch path, click `[data-action="add-media-dir"]`, and await the POST response via `page.waitForResponse()`. (B) Use `page.evaluate()` to call `fetch('/api/settings/media-dirs', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ directory: scratchDir }) })` — the browser's `security.js` interceptor will automatically attach the CSRF token. Option A is preferred for consistency with the sibling test.
